title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Medicine: A Scoping Review of Technical Implementations, Clinical Applications, and Ethical Considerations

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing medical RAG studies that evaluate differences in model outputs or performance across different patient age groups.
Reviewing medical RAG studies that evaluate differences in model outputs or performance across different sexes.
Reviewing medical RAG studies that evaluate differences in model outputs or performance across different racial groups.
Reviewing medical RAG studies that evaluate differences in model outputs or performance across different socioeconomic statuses.

Analyzing the limitations of current dense retrieval methods, specifically evaluating how the reliance on English-centric embedding models negatively impacts performance on non-English medical data and low-resource languages.
